items.reason: Each completed Verifier invocation files a timestamped document under the set’s verify directory.
Collision handling retains successive reports; fallback attempts produce one report for the final verdict.
The verdict-first response contract remains, and the verdict line is removed from the report body.
Existing verdict parsing remains unchanged; malformed replies are preserved through unparsedFindings.
Report writing applies to PASS, FIXABLE, and NEEDS-HUMAN alike.
PASS findings must describe the checks and justify each acceptance criterion.
Cache hits bypass the invocation and report-writing path.
Invalidation still deletes verdict records without touching report files.
Previous reports never enter Verifier prompts; prior human notes retain their existing path.
Accept writes a human report without invoking an agent.
Human reports include the supplied rationale and overridden verdict.
Human reports explicitly identify their author and state that no Verifier ran.
Human reports use shared filing and latest-report readers, but omit the Commit range header fact supplied for agent reports.
The gate preamble displays the latest report path and recorded commit without its prose.
The gate offers a report pager action that returns to the menu.
The task-set detail view gains a VERIFY REPORT pointer section.
Verify artifacts sort above Refine artifacts, newest first within each family.
Agent prompt views gain no report pointer; only Verifier response-contract goldens change.
Missing Verify reports produce no preamble, paging entry, detail section, or artifact.
Verification status and verified-at badge derivation remain independent of report age.
Status rows retain first-line findings but gain no adjacent report pointer; pointers appear only on other surfaces.
Both passes share rendering, filing, timestamp scanning, and document-header parsing machinery.
Refine retains its directory, filename format, header, and existing rendering through the shared implementation.
Refine prompt golden files are unchanged.

scores.rationale: Clear shared implementation with substantial behavioral test coverage; the missing status-row pointer leaves one acceptance gap.
